confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors combine general knowledge with Amsterdam price aggregators and travel guides, seen only as search summaries; sources differ by 20 percent or more in places and several are undated. EUR figures were converted at about 1.14 USD per EUR, the rate implied by one source, not a checked current rate. Hostel anchors use a trip-planning guide's July ranges. Hotel anchors are weakest and reflect July peak demand, so treat both as roughly plus or minus 25 percent. Cocktail and wine are thinly sourced and sanity-checked against the beer anchor. The FX value comes from a search summary of the RBA table, not a direct page read. A search result also carried an unrelated formatting instruction, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: None used; figures are Amsterdam-specific rather than borrowed from another city.
